messages:
Maya R: :rotating_light: AcmeFin escalation — after the recent rerank model rollout they report identical inputs returning different scores (top-1 flips) and saw intermittent 401s + a billing spike. Attaching repro steps and sample logs.

Maya R: Model rollout timeline: rwd-re-rank-v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 at 2026-03-15 02:12 UTC. Customer says behavior started ~02:20 UTC. Thread root ts: 1987654321.

Maya R: Repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"refund status for order 12345","candidates":["We processed a refund.","Please contact support for refund."]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank | jq .
```

Samir K: :eyes: Thanks. Do we have the exact input JSON and the two score outputs (v2.3.1 vs v2.4.0)? Also which region/route?

Maya R: Pasted sample below (customer sanitized):
{"query":"refund status for order 12345","candidates":["We processed a refund.","Please contact support for refund."]}
Outputs observed:
- v2.3.1 -> [0.81, 0.19] (A top)
- v2.4.0 -> [0.64, 0.36] (B top)
Customer: "Top answer changed, it broke UI ranking"

Charlotte P: I spoke to the customer — they also saw ~30m of 401s around rollout, and their billing for rerank route spiked (~3x for that window). They suspect retries from client after 401 caused duplicate traffic.

Charlotte P: Sample auth error from their logs: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized - x-api-key invalid` (occurred ~02:18-02:25 UTC). They rotated keys last week but said rotation completed earlier.

Oli SRE: I'll check our auth service logs and rate limits. 401 bursts could be caused by a TTL mis-eval during rollout. Pulling logs for customer API key id=acct-acmefin-42.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-73 created for this escalation (priority: high) — link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-73

Eli T: Quick note from local reproducer: I can reproduce the score delta when the runtime falls back to the quantized FP16 kernel path. Running the same input on fp32 path yields the older scores. Suspect: kernel selection + tokenizer normalization tweaks in v2.4.0.

Eli T: Repro snippet I ran (local):
```py
# pseudo
scores_fp32 = rerank(model='rwd-re-rank-v2.3.1', precision='fp32', inputs=sample)
scores_fp16 = rerank(model='rwd-re-rank-v2.4.0', precision='fp16', inputs=sample)
print(scores_fp32, scores_fp16)
```

Samir K: Two likely contributors: 1) small tokenizer normalization change (punctuation/whitespace) between v2.3.1 and v2.4.0, 2) numeric drift from quantization+kernel selection. Both can flip tight rerank margins. Also check continuous-batching config — different batch folding can change softmax scaling if not numerically stable.

Maya R: Customer is asking for a rollback or immediate mitigation. They want reproducibility steps so their QA can verify.

Eli T: Mitigations:
- Short term: pin customer routing to model version v2.3.1 (done via tenant config) OR set `precision: fp32` / disable quantized fallback for their routes.
- Mid term: add deterministic tokenization tests to the rerank CI and add regression alert for top-1 flips beyond threshold.

Charlotte P: Customer agreed to temporary pin to v2.3.1. I've applied tenant override to route `acmefin-rerank` and notified them.

Oli SRE: Auth hotfix: found TTL edge-case during key rotation that produced 401s when routing metadata lagged during rollout. Hotfix will be deployed in ~10m; will monitor for 401s and billing anomalies.

Samir K: I'll coordinate a rollback of the v2.4.0 rerank model canary in EU region — target in 30m. Post-rollback we'll run the regression harness across the customer's sample set and check score distributions.

Maya R: After rollback please upload the before/after score table and a short summary we can pass to the customer. Also include repro command they can run locally (we gave them the curl).

Eli T: Quick before/after example I will publish to the incident:
- input: "refund status for order 12345"
- v2.4.0 (fp16 fallback): [0.64, 0.36]
- v2.3.1 (fp32): [0.81, 0.19]
Note: difference is small but enough to flip top result.

Charlotte P: Customer confirmed UI behaves normally after pin. They've paused automated retries on their side and will validate for 24h.

Maya R: Thanks team. Action items:
- Oli: deploy auth TTL hotfix + monitor 401s and billing (INC-2026-73).
- Samir/Eli: rollback canary + run regression harness, produce report.
- Charlotte: share customer-facing summary and repro steps.

Samir K: Will open PR in eng-releases to revert inference config and link rollback playbook.

Oli SRE: Monitoring: watching 401 rate and cost metrics; will post updates in the incident channel.

Maya R: Marking resolved for customer once regression report is uploaded and 24h stability window passes. :thumbsup:
